original_hook: Headline +34.9% 24-hour gain on $ONE masks a classic momentum decay pattern. When $ONE first spiked to $0.002373, hourly volume peaked at 2.46 billion tokens. The secondary rebound reached a lower high at $0.002171 with volume cut in half (1.18 billion), before hourly volume bled down to 237 million ONE around $0.001785. Why this happens: initial market buy sweeps clear thin sell depth, but without secondary institutional inflow, subsequent rallies rely on retail re-entries that exhaust quickly. The order book thins, and price bleeds back toward range midpoints. 📊 ONE 1H: price $0.001792 • support $0.001252 • resistance $0.00239 • TP1 $0.0026745 • target $0.002959 • SL / invalidation $0.001252 (long bias). Levels are chart-derived scenarios, not guarantees. The risk to this unwind. A sudden spot volume surge above 1.5B ONE per hour breaking back over $0.002171. What confirmation on $ONE would make you treat this setup as real rather than an early headline move?
